precondition.text: VERIFY MCP-UI IS NOT ANOTHER A2UI
precondition.detail: Nothing this repository owns claims MCP-UI. Repo-wide search excluding only the two genuine submodules returns one planning-doc hit (openspec/changes/phase-2-scaffold-react-vite/tasks.md) and nothing else. Greenfield, not a divergence to repair.

blocking_decision.question: Has the MCP-UI standard solidified enough to proceed?
blocking_decision.why_it_blocks: Both definitions of record made this phase conditional on the standard solidifying ('when MCP-UI standard solidifies', 'protocol is new'). Proceeding without asking would silently discard a condition the project wrote down twice.
blocking_decision.evidence_for: @mcp-ui/client is post-1.0 at 7.1.1 — the strongest API-stability signal of the three host phases; neither AG-UI nor A2UI had that.
blocking_decision.evidence_against: @mcp-ui/server last published 2026-02-13 (~6 months); upstream repo last pushed 2026-07-08 (~7 weeks); 5,114 stars vs 15,595 (AG-UI) and 16,230 (A2UI). The server half is exactly what this phase must build against.
blocking_decision.complicating_signal: @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps (the MCP org's own extension) published 2026-07-23 — the most recent package in the space. Centre of gravity may be shifting away from @mcp-ui/*.
blocking_decision.operator_rationale: the post-1.0 client is stable enough
blocking_decision.scope_note: Scoped to the client. G-6 (server-side package choice) was left to analyze, which declined @mcp-ui/server.

analyze.key_finding: @mcp-ui/client@7.1.1 does NOT export UIResourceRenderer. Only AppRenderer and AppFrame ship, both require a hosted sandbox proxy, and @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps is a hard dependency. The phase must ship the double-iframe MCP Apps architecture.

p9_01_findings: SCHEMA DEFECT, caught by gate not review: the shipped validator (scripts/normalize-a2ui.mjs) implements `enum` but NOT `const`. A const-based discriminator would have been silently inert — the same defect class phase-8 found with oneOf-as-anyOf. Switched to single-value enum.

VALIDATOR LIMITATION, designed around: `oneOf` returns early, so any keyword beside it in the same schema object (properties, pattern, additionalProperties) is never evaluated. The natural schema shape would have left the ui:// pattern and additionalProperties inert. Each oneOf branch is now self-contained and repeats its constraints. Verified by fixture, not assumed.

SPEC-STAGE GAP: the spec stage created empty specs/ directories but wrote no delta files, so `openspec validate` failed with 'no deltas found'. Authored specs/mcp-ui-resource-conformance/spec.md; passes --strict. The other four p9 changes will hit the same gap.
session_a_note: p9-01/02/03 archived; 63/63 tasks. Session A's decisive gate — proving oneOf is genuine exclusivity rather than first-match-wins — passed twice: once against the schema directly (p9-01 1.5b) and once through the shipping normalizer (p9-02 2.3). Both used transient scratchpad copies; the repo schema was never mutated.

architecture_correction.driver: operator: agents expose MCP + HTTP + A2A + AG-UI simultaneously; UI must be identical across all of them
architecture_correction.change: direct:mcp-ui is an ENVELOPE for A2UI, not an alternative to it. resource.a2ui is REQUIRED and validated against the same A2UI schema the AG-UI web host uses.
architecture_correction.why_it_works: The A2UI renderer is FED messages (MessageProcessor.processMessages takes an array) rather than fetching them, so a surface renders under connect-src:none inside the MCP-UI sandbox.
architecture_correction.enforced_by: normalize-mcp-ui.mjs violations missing_a2ui_payload and invalid_a2ui_payload; a resource carrying the OLD A2UI dialect is rejected.

p9_04_findings: GUEST MUST BE A BUNDLE: the sandbox is opaque-origin with connect-src:none, so it cannot fetch a script. @a2ui/web_core is explicitly "building blocks for building renderers" and does NOT render DOM — React is required. The guest is therefore esbuild-bundled to a single 359KB self-contained page.

PROTOCOL SKEW, SECOND BOUNDARY: our schema validates A2UI v1.0; @a2ui/react@0.10.2 implements v0.9. Two translations needed — (1) retarget catalogId to basicCatalog.id or the renderer raises "Catalog not found"; (2) split v1.0 createSurface into v0.9 createSurface + updateComponents + updateDataModel or the surface never populates and sits at "[Loading root...]". toV09Messages() mirrors the web host toSdkMessages() deliberately so both surfaces translate identically.

DEPENDENCY PIN ERROR (mine): pinned @a2ui/web_core@0.10.2 while @a2ui/react@0.10.2 requires ^0.10.5, so pnpm installed TWO copies and tsc failed on incompatible private types. Phase-8 already had the right pin (0.10.6). The browser passed before tsc did because esbuild bundled one copy — a build gate that only ran the browser would have shipped this.

BASE SCAFFOLDER GAPS for p9-05: (a) no vitest — must be added for trust-boundary tests; (b) esbuild needed as a declared dep for the guest bundler; (c) eslint.config.js scopes only *.ts/*.tsx so Node .mjs build scripts fail no-undef on `process` — needs a src/dev/**/*.mjs override.
